Thanks for the quick reply, Oliver — totally understand. Answers below are high level; happy to expand.

- VPC support: yes. We support a private deployment model (VPC / customer-managed networking) for cases with strict outbound rules. Most customers either use Redwood Dedicated in a VPC or deploy Redwood Private on-prem / in a private subnet.

- Cost ballpark (very rough): for steady 10 RPS at ~1k tokens per request, Hosted will generally be higher per-token but minimal operational overhead — think ~2.5–4x the incremental unit cost vs optimized Dedicated with reserved capacity. Dedicated (reserved) usually becomes economical if you have consistent throughput and need isolation. I can run a quick estimate if you share the expected active hours and peak concurrency.

If you’d like the async recap, I attached a short 2-minute voice recap (quick-recap-voicemail-20260923.mp4) that summarizes the demo I intended to show and the short checklist answers. If you prefer, here’s a direct 15-min slot: https://cal.com/rohan/redwood-15
